_comment: Read by the plugin at startup, in the background, and compared on the machine that read it.
Nothing is sent: this is a static file and the plugin never says which version it is running.
Set minimum_safe to the first version that is safe. Every older installation then stops serving
its verbs and tells its user why. Grasshopper and Rhino are untouched; only the link withdraws.
This disables software on other users' machines. Raising minimum_safe is a decision for a vulnerability
that can affect users, not for an ordinary bug. The commit records that decision, so write the reason
for the user reading it, not for the repository maintainers.
It fails open: no network, no notice, no effect. PHENOME_IGNORE_ADVISORY=1 overrides it.
reason: a web page you visit could drive the canvas and run code in Rhino.
